# headwater

> headwater is an open-source Python library and command line for life cycle assessment (LCA): it scores databases and studies kept as plain files in git, on frozen background releases, with the provenance of every number.

Install with `pip install headwater`, try it with `headwater demo headwater-demo`, and give an AI agent its skill with `headwater skill install` (or `uv tool run library-skills --claude`). Every command but `skill show` takes `--json`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/README.md): what headwater is, the quick start, and using it with an AI agent
- [How it works](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): the three ideas behind headwater, on one toy T-shirt
- [Workflows](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/docs/workflows.md): setup, every command and its options, JSON output and exit codes, git and CI
- [Calculation](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/docs/calculation.md): how scores are computed and explained, and the Python API
- [Design](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/docs/design.md): principles, data model and file formats
- [Decisions](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): what is settled and why, and what is still open
- [The skill](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/src/headwater/.agents/skills/headwater/SKILL.md): the guide an AI agent reads, shipped in the package

## Notebooks

- [Notebooks](https://github.com/LeonardoNatale/headwater/blob/main/notebooks/README.md): a first footprint, writing a database, a case study on invented data, ecoinvent, and coming from Brightway
